story.fullStory:
Gap Band's "Burn Rubber On Me" — original release 1967. "Burn Rubber (Why You Wanna Hurt Me)" is an American funk song originally performed by the Gap Band in 1980 and written by member Charlie Wilson, Rudy Taylor, and producer Lonnie Simmons.

Chart performance
In 1981, it peaked at number 84 on the Billboard Hot 100, number 90 on Cash Box and number 1 on the R&B charts.

Billboard magazine ranked it as the 12th biggest R&B single of 1981.

The Gap Band has released over 30 albums.

Chart performance
In 1981, it peaked at number 84 on the Billboard Hot 100, number 90 on Cash Box and number 1 on the R&B charts.
Billboard magazine ranked it as the 12th biggest R&B single of 1981.
The Gap Band has released over 30 albums.
Since their inception in 1967,  the Gap Band has released 15 studio albums, 12 compilation albums and 2 live albums.
They released nine self-titled albums (including two of the same name).
The Gap Band was an American R&B and funk band that rose to fame during the 1970s and 1980s.
